categories.name: Tenant isolation
categories.description: Each user's projects and files are strictly separated; ownership is checked on every access.

categories.name: Path containment
categories.description: Uploads and edits are jailed to the project; path-traversal attempts are rejected.

categories.name: Command-injection hardening
categories.description: All shell, SSH, and SLURM arguments are safely quoted.

categories.name: SSRF protection
categories.description: Server-side URL fetches are restricted to public hosts; internal and loopback addresses are blocked.

categories.name: Deserialization safety
categories.description: No untrusted pickle or marshal; only safe YAML loaders are used.

categories.name: Sandboxed compute
categories.description: Each visitor's terminal and compute run inside a per-user Apptainer sandbox, never a host shell.

categories.name: Authentication boundaries
categories.description: Admin and onsite actions require real authentication; there are no bypass paths.

categories.name: Automated regression gates
categories.description: Automated security tests run on every commit to keep these protections from regressing.
